notes: MG1655 with pBR322-toxIN or empty pBR322, 0-30 min after T4 infection (MOI 5) at 30 C. All samples are listed as post-infection, including 0 min, so all get treatment phage (acute) and no sample is an untreated control: is_control left out. Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.2-0.35 before infection (<=30 min after). toxIN origin not stated: genotype_class left out for +toxIN. mixed_organism left out: infected cells contain phage RNA. ERCC spike-in in rep2 (synthetic RNA). Libraries gel-extracted after PCR = library size selection, total_rnaseq.
